ai_suggestion.suggestion: Use 'was' or 'were' to show cause and effect. 'The' is more common in informal situations. Contoh yang benar: She was reading a book when I called.
Use 'by' to show duration, location, and duration. Contoh yang benar: By the time she arrived, I had already left.
Use past tense 'have been waiting for an hour'. 'Hour' is singular, so use 'have been'. Contoh yang benar: I have been waiting for an hour.

Use 'should have + past participle' in the if-clause for past hypothetical situations. Contoh yang benar: You should have told me earlier!
